description: This file contains utility functions for WiFi management, system event handling, semaphore initialization, daemonization, and message sending in a C-based embedded or network device software project.

methods.name: rdkb_sysevent_open
methods.description: Opens a system event connection, placeholder implementation returning 0.

methods.name: rdkb_sysevent_close
methods.description: Closes a system event connection, placeholder implementation returning 0.

methods.name: rdkb_wifi_enableCSIEngine
methods.description: Enables or disables the CSI engine for a specified access point and station.

methods.name: rdkb_daemonize
methods.description: Daemonizes the process, sets up semaphores, and redirects standard file descriptors to /dev/null.

methods.name: rdkb_sendWebpaMsg
methods.description: Sends a WebPA message with specified parameters.

methods.name: wifi_misc_init
methods.description: Initializes the wifi_misc_t structure with function pointers to the above functions.
